scheme_name: Grant Scheme for Marriage of SC and ST Girls
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand
Applicant must belong to the BPL (Below Poverty Level) category
Assistance can be availed for the marriage of a maximum of two daughters in a family
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per beneficiary for the marriage of eligible SC/ST girls.
